name: feature-ladder
description: Orchestration ladder for adding features, atomically: a Sonnet intake scout settles every routing variable and asks once (including how many subagents the session may spawn), then one cheap worker (GLM 5.3 Flash through OpenRouter, or Sonnet medium) implements just the change and its tests on its own branch, checked by a script. Hooks enforce the session budget and keep reviews, scribes and Fable rungs out of feature runs; Codex review, second opinions and memory run once per session at /feature-ladder:wrap. Deterministic model routing and skill selection, per-repository Hindsight memory behind a strict gate.
